Cloud Applications Resource Bulk Update Cloud Application
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/cloudApplications/bulkUpdate

Updates application status and tag information for predefined or custom cloud applications based on the IDs specified

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
sanctionedState
string

The cloud application status that indicates whether it is sanctioned or unsanctioned

Possible values: [UN_SANCTIONED, SANCTIONED, ANY]

applicationIds
int32[]

The list of cloud application IDs for which the status (sanctioned or unsanctioned) and tags have to be updated

customTags
object[]
Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
